title: Coefficient-sized slice-contractible cover inside connected components
statement: Every Noetherian scheme X admits a covering of the final object of its coefficient-sized pro-etale model, indexed in max(v,u+1), by affine objects V_i satisfying AdicResidueSliceWeaklyContractible from [def-sfb-adic-residue-lift-comparisons]. For each i there is a specified base point z_i of X such that the image of the underlying scheme of V_i lies in the connected component of z_i. Empty X is permitted.

proof.text: Connected components are open in a Noetherian scheme and cover it. Regard their open immersions as objects of its small pro-etale site.

Refine each component by spectra of w-contractible rings. Covers of such spectra admit disjoint monomorphic covering refinements. Transport the refinements into the AsSmall slice; gluing lifts sections through every epimorphism in the required coefficient universe.

Compose the covers by transitivity, lift the sigma index to the coefficient universe, and use CoversTop to pass from the identity object to the chosen final object. The factorization through each component proves the image inclusion.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_coefficient_connected_contractible_cover
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    ∃ (I : Type (max v (u + 1)))
      (V : I → coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X)
      (f : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶
        (AsSmall.up : X.ProEt ⥤ coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X).obj (⊤_ X.ProEt)),
      Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X _ ∧
      ∀ i : I,
        IsAffine ((AsSmall.down : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X ⥤ X.ProEt).obj
          (V i)).left ∧
        AdicResidueSliceWeaklyContractible.{u, v} X (V i) ∧
        ∃ z : X, Set.range
          (((AsSmall.down : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X ⥤ X.ProEt).obj
            (V i)).hom.base) ⊆ connectedComponent z
